defects.description: Description: Lie on the SIDE. Current globalRoll=-15 (only 15° roll to LEFT side) — body is mostly prone-leaning (globalTilt=75) with slight tilt, NOT on side. Need globalRoll closer to ±60 for clearer side-lying.

Description: both hands tucked under the cheek as if sleeping. Current wrists at y=-0.028/-0.137 (floor level), z=0.082/-0.044 (body center, behind head z=0.889). Hands at floor NOT under cheek. Need to raise arms up to face level via shoulder abduction + deep elbow bend to bring hands to cheek.

Description: knees drawn up gently. Current leftHip=40, rightHip=30 (moderate flexion) + leftKnee=30, rightKnee=20 (mild bend). Knees at y=-0.294/-0.315 (below hips). Mildly drawn up but could be deeper for sleeping curl.

failing_tests: description says lie on side but globalRoll only -15°
description says hands tucked under cheek but wrists at floor level not face level
description says knees drawn up gently but knees barely flexed
regression_risk: medium-high — 10-field rework to convert partial-prone pose to side-lying sleeping pose. Hands-tucked-under-cheek is rig-limited (no horizontal adduction, cannot truly clasp hands under cheek). Approximation: both arms raised overhead + deep elbow bend brings hands to face/cheek level.
rationale: Description: Lie on the side with both hands tucked under the cheek as if sleeping, knees drawn up gently. Current pose is mostly prone-leaning (globalTilt=75, globalRoll=-15) with hands at floor — does NOT match side-lying sleeping pose. Per protocol §4 use description. Fix: (1) globalRoll -15→-60 (deeper side roll to LEFT, body more clearly on side). (2) Hands under cheek: leftShoulder -10→-90 + rightShoulder 8→-90 (both arms raised overhead, in side-lying this brings arms up alongside head); leftElbow 81→140 + rightElbow 18→140 (deep bend brings hands DOWN from overhead to face/cheek level — approximation of tucked under cheek). (3) Knees drawn up: leftHip 40→70, rightHip 30→65, leftKnee 30→80, rightKnee 20→80 (deeper flexion for sleeping curl). (4) spine 0→12 (slight forward curl for sleeping position). Rig-limited: no horizontal adduction joint, cannot truly clasp hands together under cheek; renderer elbow rotY only. Hands-near-cheek is best approximation. Re-render verify REQUIRED.
